evals.name: single-function-in-isolation
evals.setup: `Parse` has one happy-path test, `Test_Parse`, and two uncovered error branches. A caller's test, `Test_Load`, incidentally executes one of those branches, so a whole-package coverage run credits `Parse` with more than its own test earns.

evals.name: package-target-is-plan-first
evals.setup: `./pkg/svc` holds six exported functions, four of them partly covered.

evals.name: deferred-and-uncoverable-are-reported
evals.setup: `Dial` has one branch reachable only behind a network seam and one defensive `return` that no input can reach. The run is repeated afterwards with `include=all`.

evals.name: module-mode-honors-its-controls
evals.setup: A module of nine packages, two of them `svc` and `api`.

evals.name: writes-into-existing-tests
evals.setup: `Test_Encode_tabular` already exists for the target function, covering happy-path rows. The uncovered lines are two more happy-path shapes, not error branches. A helper in `all_test.go` loses its last caller during the edit.

evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup: An ordinary single-function run that adds two table rows.

evals.name: no-seam-stays-deferred-under-include-all
evals.setup: `Upload` calls `http.Post` directly on a package-level client with no injection point. The branch handling a failed POST is reachable only by adding a seam to the production code.

evals.name: missing-test-family-is-not-zero-percent
evals.setup: `Normalize` has no test whose name matches its direct-test family — the only test touching it is `TestNormalizeHelper`, off-convention.

evals.name: only-and-max-changes-filters
evals.setup: `./pkg/svc` holds four exported functions and three unexported ones, all partly covered. The run caps the work and restricts it to exported symbols.
